dedupe_keys.name: multi robot coordination for emergency evacuation via adversarial reinforcement learning with complex crowd behavior and dynamic hazard modeling

description: Ruhao Luan and colleagues publish a Unity and ML-Agents implementation for robot-assisted emergency evacuation. Zenodo archives version 1.0.0 under MIT for software, while its experiment data use CC BY 4.0. The description identifies frozen robot and human policies, training settings, dynamic hazards, and a zero-shot team-size comparison from one to five robots with three seeds and 100 episodes per seed. This model can test robot-coordination and crowd-routing assumptions in an evacuation simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Unity implementation. Coverage is the curated virtual scene and tested policies, not deployment in a real emergency. A limitation is that simulation transfer depends on crowd realism, hazard dynamics and robot sensing; the reported episode statistics are not field validation. The model and data archive were not downloaded, Unity was not run and policy scores were not independently reproduced.
